record.detailed_failure_scope: At R4 both side-contours report generic ChFiDS_Error with computed surfaces, no faulty vertices or partial result. This does not establish radius-too-large, corner-filling failure, or a precise numerical cause.

evidence.finding: Add builds tangent-edge contours and sets radius/law; no supplied-limits gap-patch switch.
SetContinuity controls produced fillet surface continuity; it is not limits-gap patch yes/no.
HasResult/BadShape describe incomplete corner filling and diagnostics, not a valid source patch_no mode.
Internal corner-processing/extending framework, not limit_topols+unders API.
PerformMoreThreeCorner obtains a shared vertex and incident edges; scope is multi-fillet vertex corner construction.
Internal multi-corner construction uses a G1 GeomPlate problem; this is not the source limit-gap patch option.
Three-corner processing can dispatch to multi-corner plate construction.
General constrained surface filling with ordered boundaries; incompatible constraints may be unsatisfied.
Manual filling can add C0/G1/G2 edge/support constraints; does not itself identify blend limits/underlying topology or reconstruct source operation.
Shape.makeFillet accepts radius and target edge list only.
FreeCAD invokes native MakeFillet and Add(r1,r2,edge).
StripeStatus 1 is generic ChFiDS_Error, not StartsolFailure or WalkingFailure.
Explicit read.surfacecurve.mode=0, write.surfacecurve.mode=1, write.precision.mode=0 used in this run.

A failed/partial native fillet with holes is not the source valid no-patch result.
No original model, page, kernel or persistent preferences modified.
